sentences.en: Warm weather is good for me.
sentences.zh: 温暖的天气对我来说很好。

sentences.en: This food is not good for him.
Walking in the morning is good.
Playing together is good for us.
The sea is better than the mountains to me.
Loud noise is bad for her.
Resting after work is good for them.
sentences.zh: 工作后休息对他们很好。
